lyrics:
[Intro: slide guitar, foot stomps, a humming choir]

[Verse 1: smoky female voice, weary]
I go at noon when the sun's straight up
Nobody's there to look at me funny with their cup
Five tries at love and none of 'em stuck
I carry my own water. I don't ask for much.

[Chorus: choir answers, stomps and claps]
Then a stranger said, "Meet me at the well"
Knew my whole story, didn't look away
Said, "I got water, you won't thirst again"
Like rain on a tin roof in the dust of the day
I came with a bucket, I left it where it fell
Meet me at the well

[Verse 2: voice waking up, guitar and bass]
He told me everything I ever did
Didn't flinch, didn't lecture, didn't quit
I said, "I hear there's a Messiah coming, one day"
He said, "You're talking to him." Just like that. Plain as day.

[Chorus: choir answers, stomps and claps]
And the stranger said, "Meet me at the well"
Knew my whole story, didn't look away
Said, "I got water, you won't thirst again"
Like rain on a tin roof in the dust of the day
I came with a bucket, I left it where it fell
Meet me at the well

[Bridge: stomps and choir only, building]
I ran to town, me, the one they talk about
Yelling, "Come and see! Come and see!"
Come and see a man who knows it all and stays
Come and see Jesus, sitting by the well

[Final Chorus: full choir, slide guitar wailing]
Jesus said, "Meet me at the well"
Knew my whole story, didn't look away
Said, "I got water, you won't thirst again"
Like rain on a tin roof in the dust of the day
I came with a bucket, I left it where it fell
Meet me at the well

[Outro: stomps, water pouring, humming]
producerBrief:
TEMPO / KEY / FEEL: 88 BPM, 4/4 with a swampy swing, E minor, with major chords in the chorus. A slow, heavy gospel-blues stomp.

VOICE: Female lead, smoky and worn in verse 1, brightening through the song until she is shouting with joy in the bridge. A choir of rough, mixed voices hums under the verses and answers every chorus line.

INSTRUMENTS: Slide guitar on a resonator, foot stomps and handclaps, a kick drum and tambourine, upright bass, a gritty electric guitar, Hammond organ, the sound of water poured from a jug at the end.

ARRANGEMENT MAP: 0:00 Intro, slide guitar, stomps and humming. 0:14 Verse 1. 0:42 Chorus 1. 1:12 Verse 2, 'You're talking to him'. 1:40 Chorus 2. 2:10 Bridge, stomps and choir. 2:36 Final chorus. 3:06 Outro, stomps, water and humming, ends 3:26.

PRODUCTION & MIX: Swampy and live: stomps on a wooden floor, the choir close, guitars a little dirty.

SIGNATURE MOMENT: 'He said, "You're talking to him." Just like that.' at 1:28.

THE REVEAL: Verse 1 and the first chorus are a tired woman and a kind stranger. Verse 2 at 1:12 is the conversation in John chapter 4, ending with his plain answer. The bridge has her run to town, and the name comes with it.

EMOTIONAL ARC: Ashamed, seen, astonished, running to tell.
